quirks.lineage: Modular-architecture AVP build; menu skeleton identical to hummod_3.0.4 (Stop=6, Go 12-30, Trauma/Hemorrhage=741); verified by engine_smoke with the 3.0.4 profile. Ships Model Solver.exe + ScriptedController.exe.
quirks.app_title: HumMod : Integrative Biomedicine (v3.1.0) - the AVP engine is actually HumMod v3.1.0 (window title, verified 2026-11 R1 baseline run).
quirks.auto_profile_unreachable: _detect_profile matches its Trauma/Sizing menu to hummod_3.0.4, so this profile is only used when a server is started with HUMMOD_PROFILE=avphummod. Functionally harmless: menu ids and quirks are identical to 3.0.4 (R1 full-parameter run passed with the 3.0.4 profile).
quirks.variable_names_differ_from_304: SOL group names differ from 3.0.4: PO2Veins/CO2Veins (not *Vens), O2Artys/O2Veins.[O2], A2Pool.[A2(pMol/L)], FAPool, KAPool, TriglyceridePool, BodyH2O.TotalVol(L) (TBW), PeripheralResistance.TPR, CollectingDuct_H2O.Outflow (urine flow), organ consumption in *-Fuel.TotalGlucoseUsed(mG/Min)/FAUsed(mG/Min)/KAUsed(mG/Min). See out/experiments/baseline_avp/基线参数表.md.
quirks.no_clinic_menu: Top-level menus: Circulation, Respiration, Metabolism, Body Fluids, Electrolytes, Hormones, ... Gender, Nervous System, Acid-Base, Heat, Miscellaneous, Organs, Lifestyle, Diagnosis, Intervention, Trauma, Pathology, Context, Sizing. Manual's Clinic->Chart is the startup Chart page (via '<' '>' pager).
quirks.slider_pages: Most sliders commit via THUMBPOSITION+ENDSCROLL (R2 field trial 2026-11): Lifestyle/Environment Temp(F)=pos-30 (pos 130 -> 100 F, beyond-nominal-range positions accepted), Wind MPH=pos; Lifestyle/Exercise/Treadmill Speed(MPH)=pos*0.5; Lifestyle/Diet/Control H2O 'Fixed Intake' L/Day=pos*0.1 (ctrl 10140, ordinal 2 of 4). EXCEPTION: Lifestyle/Diet/Goal scrollers (nutrition kCal + electrolyte steppers) do NOT commit at any position - same fault as 3.0.4 Goal page (B-3). Water goal is NOT on Diet/Goal in v3.1.0 (page holds only Nutrition/Electrolytes); it lives on Diet/Control H2O group.
quirks.radio_pages: R2 field trial: Lifestyle/Posture ordinal 7 of 8 = Request Standing (PostureControl.Request=3, Status.Posture=3); Lifestyle/Exercise/Control ordinal 2 of 3 = Treadmill (Status.Treadmill=1); Lifestyle/Exercise/Treadmill ordinal 0 of 2 = Walk (Exercise-Treadmill.RunOrWalk=0); Lifestyle/Diet/Control ordinal 3 of 4 = H2O Fixed Intake (DietIntakeH2O.Fixed?=1; H2O radios 10136/10138 DO expose check state). All other radios keep state in the model only - verify with probe_vars.
